title: Resend Geek Command from Get AGV Status using the command GUID (for unplanned restart / missed request recovery)
summary: Use the Get AGV Status / APIs surface to resend a Geek Plus request via the “ResendGeekCommand” function by supplying the required command GUID. This is intended to recover when Geek Plus may have missed the original request after an unplanned restart.
when_to_use: Use when an unplanned restart occurred and Geek Plus may have missed the request, and you need to resend the Geek command using the required command GUID.
roles_and_responsibilities: L2_support: Execute the resend by providing the correct command GUID to the “ResendGeekCommand” function and verify the resulting command status update in Get Command Status / Get AGV Status.
access_or_tools_needed: Access to the Get AGV Status / APIs interface that includes “ResendGeekCommand”
Access to “GET command status” to view the “main GUID”
Command GUID from the “command database model”

access_required: Get AGV Status / APIs interface with “ResendGeekCommand”
Get Command Status view (to obtain the main GUID)
system_preconditions: A command GUID is available/identifiable for the affected command (the resend function requires a command GUID).

visual_references.description: Get AGV Status / APIs panel showing “ResendGeekCommand” and the note that Geek command requires a command GUID; also indicates main GUID visibility in GET command status.

steps.title: Locate “ResendGeekCommand” on the Get AGV Status / APIs area and identify where the command GUID is sourced/entered
steps.purpose: Confirm the correct resend capability and the required command GUID input source before attempting the resend.
steps.instruction: On the Get AGV Status / APIs area, find the “ResendGeekCommand” capability. Use the same surface to identify the required “command GUID” input requirement.
steps.expected_result: You can see the “ResendGeekCommand” capability and understand that it requires a command GUID from the command database model.
steps.healthy_condition: The UI/API surface clearly shows “ResendGeekCommand” and indicates the command GUID requirement.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot locate “ResendGeekCommand” or cannot determine where the command GUID must be provided.

actions.label: Open Get AGV Status / APIs and find ResendGeekCommand
actions.exact_action: Locate the “ResendGeekCommand” capability on the Get AGV Status / APIs area.

stop_or_escalate_if: If “ResendGeekCommand” cannot be found on the Get AGV Status / APIs area, stop and escalate (no further recovery steps are provided in the source).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “Geek command requires a command GUID from the command database model.” and “ResendGeekCommand … It will resend the request to Geek Plus.”

steps.title: Obtain the correct command GUID for the affected command (main GUID from Get Command Status)
steps.purpose: Provide the required command GUID to the resend function.
steps.instruction: Use the Get Command Status view to obtain the “main GUID” for the affected command. The source states the main GUID is visible in GET command status.
steps.expected_result: You have the correct command GUID (main GUID) for the affected command that will be used for the resend.
steps.healthy_condition: The Get Command Status view shows the main GUID that corresponds to the affected command.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot identify the command GUID from Get Command Status (main GUID).

actions.label: Check Get Command Status for main GUID
actions.exact_action: Use “GET command status” to view the “main GUID”.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the correct command GUID cannot be identified from Get Command Status (main GUID), stop and escalate.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “You can also see that in the GET command status there is the main GUID as well.”

steps.title: Enter/provide the command GUID to the “ResendGeekCommand” function
steps.purpose: Supply the required command GUID so the resend request can be issued to Geek Plus.
steps.instruction: In the “ResendGeekCommand” function on the Get AGV Status / APIs area, enter/provide the command GUID you obtained (main GUID from Get Command Status).
steps.expected_result: The “ResendGeekCommand” function has the command GUID populated/provided as required.
steps.healthy_condition: The command GUID field/input for “ResendGeekCommand” is filled with the identified main GUID.
steps.failure_condition: The command GUID is missing, incorrect, or cannot be provided to the resend function.

actions.label: Provide commandGuid to ResendGeekCommand
actions.exact_action: Enter/provide the command GUID to the “ResendGeekCommand” function (requires a command GUID).

stop_or_escalate_if: Do not attempt to resend without the command GUID requirement being satisfied.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “Geek command requires a command GUID from the command database model.” and “ResendGeekCommand … It will resend the request to Geek Plus.”

steps.title: Execute the resend so the request is resent to Geek Plus
steps.purpose: Trigger the resend action to Geek Plus using the provided command GUID.
steps.instruction: Execute the “ResendGeekCommand” resend action on the Get AGV Status / APIs area.
steps.expected_result: The resend action is performed (the request is resent to Geek Plus).
steps.healthy_condition: The resend action completes on the surface (no explicit success message is provided in the source; verification is done in the next step via command status).
steps.failure_condition: The resend action cannot be executed or does not result in any observable command status change.

actions.label: Execute ResendGeekCommand
actions.exact_action: Execute the resend so it “resend[s] their request to Geek Plus.”

stop_or_escalate_if: If the resend does not result in any observable change in command status, stop and escalate.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “ResendGeekCommand … It will resend the request to Geek+.” and “Helpful in the event of an unplanned restart and Geek+ missed the request.”

steps.title: Confirm resend outcome by re-checking Get Command Status / Get AGV Status
steps.purpose: Verify that the resend had an observable effect on command status.
steps.instruction: Re-check the Get Command Status / Get AGV Status display for updated command status information after executing “ResendGeekCommand.”
steps.expected_result: Get Command Status / Get AGV Status reflects updated command status information consistent with the resend.
steps.healthy_condition: Command status information on the Get Command Status / Get AGV Status surface changes after the resend.
steps.failure_condition: No observable change in command status is seen after the resend.

actions.label: Re-check command status after resend
actions.exact_action: Confirm the resend action was performed by re-checking the Get Command Status / Get AGV Status display for updated command status information.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the resend does not result in any observable change in command status, stop and escalate.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Get AGV status shows current state/command vitals and includes the resend capability; the source notes the main GUID is visible in GET command status.

success_criteria: The “ResendGeekCommand” resend is executed using a command GUID (main GUID from Get Command Status).
After execution, Get Command Status / Get AGV Status shows updated command status information (observable change).
healthy_conditions: Get AGV Status shows current state of AGVs, current command vitals, and any AGV/system errors on the surface.
Get Command Status displays the main GUID used for the resend.
failure_conditions: Correct command GUID cannot be identified from Get Command Status (main GUID).
Resend does not result in any observable change in command status.
escalation_guidance: If the correct command GUID cannot be identified from Get Command Status (main GUID) or if the resend does not result in any observable change in command status, stop and escalate. The source does not provide additional recovery steps beyond this resend approach.
